rule: packet type = upper 4 bits of mqtt.hdrflags
PUBLISH: low 4 bits of hdrflags = DUP<<3 | QoS<<1 | RETAIN
PUBLISH: message ID present (non-zero) only if QoS > 0

basis: MQTT 3.1.1 §3.1.2.3 (will flags are constant 0 in this data)

rule: CONNECT: password flag = 1 only if username flag = 1
protoname / proto_len / ver / kalive / conflags appear only in CONNECT
conack.flags / conack.val appear only in CONNACK
rows with no MQTT header have every MQTT field absent/zero
MQTT rows: tcp.len >= mqtt.len + 2 (header + length byte)
MQTT rows: tcp.len == mqtt.len + 2 (exactly one small MQTT packet per segment)
